name: prioritize
question: Q2 Revenue-cycle lead: which denied claims should staff work first today?
label: model_estimate
note: Simulated data for a fictional hospital. Results show whether the method recovers the generator's planted behaviour and whether the decision rule behaves correctly; they are not findings about real payers.

appeal_window_days.label: financial_assumption
appeal_window_days.source: Assumption. Provider appeal deadlines are set by each payer contract. For context, Medicare's first-level appeal (redetermination) must be filed within 120 days of receiving the initial determination (42 CFR 405.942). A single 90-day window is used for every simulated payer.

loaded_hourly_cost_usd.label: financial_assumption
loaded_hourly_cost_usd.note: implied: cost per appeal / minutes per appeal x 60

effort_multiplier_by_reason.label: financial_assumption
effort_multiplier_by_reason.source: Assumption, illustrative and not measured. Relative staff effort per appeal by denial category (clinical-record appeals take longer than demographic corrections). Multiplies the configured minutes per appeal. A uniform-effort sensitivity (all multipliers 1) is reported alongside.

assumptions.business_days: weekdays (public holidays ignored in the replay)
assumptions.timing_independence: The backtest assumes an appeal's outcome does not depend on the day it is filed inside the window, so a claim worked on another day than in reality keeps its realised outcome.

test_appeals.label: synthetic_record
test_appeals.note: appeals on denials dated on or after the cutoff, outcome known by the as-of date

model.formula: overturned ~ C(payer_id, Treatment(reference='P03')) + C(reason_category, Treatment(reference='PRIOR_AUTH')) + C(service_line_code, Treatment(reference='INFUSION')) + ln_amount_c + age_months

backtest.description: Every weekday from the cutoff to the as-of date each policy picks claims inside the appeal window under the daily budget; a worked claim leaves the pool. ALL_DENIALS scores choices with the model's expected value (circular for the knapsack, which maximises it by construction); APPEALED_WITH_OUTCOME scores them with the realised outcome and paid amount.
backtest.label: model_estimate

candidates.label: synthetic_record
candidates.note: claims whose latest status is DENIED with no action yet
